newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms P&O A minus corp credit rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms P&O A minus corp credit rating.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it affirmed its A minus corporate credit rating of The Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Company (P&O).
It said in a statement that the outlook on this rating remained stable.
The rating affirmation follows the announcement on Monday that P&O is to merge its container shipping operation with the container division of Netherlands-based Royal Nedlloyd N.V (N.R.) .
The merged entity, to be known as P&O Nedlloyd, will be held 50 percent by each parent, and will be one of the largest players in the industry, the statement said.
A corporate credit rating is an indication of the creditworthiness of a company as a whole and is not assigned to a specific debt issue, S&P said.

S&P said it is expected significant cost reductions will be achieved by P&O Nedlloyd. The extent to which these savings are passed on to customers in the form of lower rates would partly be a function of the speed of industry consolidation.

Since P&O and Nedlloyd currently belong to different global alliances of container shipping companies, their merger is likely to lead to a reshuffle of industry partnerships in the form of new alliances or mergers, the statement added.
S&P said P&O's rating reflected the strength of the UK-based group's diversified shipping interests, a portfolio of investment property, and a reasonable financial profile.
The most significant operations are P&O Cruises, the industry's third largest player, and a sizable portfolio of investment property in the UK and North America.

Though the trading performance of most of the group's operations had improved recently -- with the exception of the container and ferry operations -- the financial profile was considered relatively weak within the rating category, S&P said.

S&P said a substantial debt burden offset P&O's strong operating positions. Asset disposals and the proposed container operation merger would help the financial profile though capital expenditure will stay high in P&O Cruises, the statement said. -- International Bonds Unit +44 171 6320
